help.summary.title: Summary
help.summary.summary: Where you stand at a glance — what you owe, what you have paid, which drives are open, and what the family holds.
help.summary.what-it-is.heading: A digest, not a screen of its own
help.summary.what-it-is.b0: [Summary](/accounting/summary) shows the headline of each of the four things below it and names where the rest is. Nothing lives only here — every figure has a screen behind it, reached from the link beside its heading or from the **Accounting** section of the rail.
help.summary.what-it-is.b1.i0.text: What you owe and what the next payment comes to. In full on [Dues](/accounting/dues-and-donations).
help.summary.what-it-is.b1.i1.text: Your total for the year, broken down by schedule. In full on [Payment History](/reporting/payment-history).
help.summary.what-it-is.b1.i2.text: The drives still running. Closed ones are counted here and listed on [Donations](/accounting/dues-and-donations?pane=donations).
help.summary.what-it-is.b1.i3.text: Every fund the family keeps and what each holds. There is no separate screen for this one.
help.summary.what-you-see.heading: Why a section might be missing
help.summary.what-you-see.b0: Each of the four is granted separately, and Summary shows only the ones you hold. A section you cannot see is one your family has not given you — see [Who can do what](/help/who-can-do-what). If you hold none of them, the page says so rather than showing you empty headings.
help.summary.what-you-see.b1: Whatever you have been granted, the money figures here are yours. Nothing on this page shows another member's dues, payments or giving. Family Funds is the exception in kind rather than in privacy: a fund balance belongs to the whole family, and it names nobody.
